HOW WE WORK

Rigour in the analysis.
Practicality in the response.

We structure advisory work around a decision, an evidence base and a realistic path to action. The institution’s mandate sets the direction.

01

Frame the mandate

Agree the problem, decision requirements, stakeholders and intended outcomes. Establish scope, methods, responsibilities and limitations.

Inception report · workplan · stakeholder map
02

Understand the operating reality

Combine documentary review, stakeholder consultation and value-chain analysis. Distinguish what is verified, what is uncertain and what requires further work.

Diagnostic · evidence register · options assessment
03

Design a feasible response

Assess options against institutional capacity, incentives, risks and development objectives. Define sequencing and responsibilities.

Operational framework · roadmap · results framework
04

Validate and enable ownership

Test findings and recommendations with relevant stakeholders. Provide decision-ready summaries and support knowledge transfer.

Validation package · management brief · handover materials

ENGAGEMENT PRINCIPLES

Accountability begins
with how we work.

Evidence and intellectual honesty

Separate demonstrated capability, emerging technical models and proposed interventions.

Safeguards and inclusion

Consider environmental and occupational risks, gender inclusion, vulnerable groups and participation barriers in the design.

Institutional ownership

Make responsibilities clear and outputs usable beyond the assignment.
